title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2605 of 23 November 2026 amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union, and in particular Article 29 thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 4
amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 5

paras.text: On 26 February 2026, the Council adopted Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 ( 1 ) .
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 6
amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 7

paras.text: In view of the continued threat posed by The Base, one person should be added to the lists in Annexes II and IV to Decision (CFSP) 2026/455.
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 8
amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 9

paras.text: Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 10

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: amending Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, para 11

paras.text: Annexes II and IV to Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 are amended in accordance with the Annex to this Decision.
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
Done at Brussels, 23 November 2026.
For the Council
The President
M. HEYDON

( 1 ) Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 of 26 February 2026 on restrictive measures to combat terrorism, repealing Articles 2, 3 and 3a of Common Position 2001/931/CFSP on the application of specific measures to combat terrorism and repealing Decision (CFSP) 2025/1577 and Decision (CFSP) 2026/421 ( OJ L, 2026/455, 26.2.2026, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2026/455/oj ).
Annexes II and IV to Decision (CFSP) 2026/455 are amended as follows:

in Annex II, under the heading ‘A. Natural persons’, the following entry is added: ‘1. NAZZARO Rinaldo (a.k.a. Norman Spear, Roman Wolf); POB: United States of America; Nationality: United States of America; Gender: male.’;
NAZZARO Rinaldo (a.k.a. Norman Spear, Roman Wolf); POB: United States of America; Nationality: United States of America; Gender: male.’;
in Annex IV, the following entry is added: ‘1. NAZZARO Rinaldo (a.k.a. Norman Spear, Roman Wolf); POB: United States of America; Nationality: United States of America; Gender: male.’.
